title: Rajasthan State Electricity Board (RSEB) v. Mohan Lal

content.caseIdentity: Rajasthan State Electricity Board (RSEB) v. Mohan Lal, AIR 1967 SC 1857
content.holding: Overruled the ejusdem generis restriction; "other authorities" in Article 12 includes all authorities created by the Constitution or statutes endowed with legal power.
content.relevance: Foundational break from restrictive interpretation of Article 12.
